flags.why: The example refers to a mixed rice-noodle dish, so it does not establish a separate meaning ‘dish made from rice crackers’ ([source](https://vov.gov.vn/hoc-cach-lam-mon-banh-da-tron-sieu-ngon-la-mieng-ngay-tai-nha-dtnew-208856)).
flags.fix: Remove sense 3 and move its example to sense 1.

flags.why: ‘Bánh đa trộn’ here means mixed rice noodles, rather than a mixed rice-cracker dish ([source](https://vov.gov.vn/hoc-cach-lam-mon-banh-da-tron-sieu-ngon-la-mieng-ngay-tai-nha-dtnew-208856)).
flags.fix: This shop sells mixed rice noodles and is always crowded.

flags.why: ‘Bát âm’ denotes a traditional instrumental ensemble or its music, rather than any musical octet ([source](https://bktt.vn/B%C3%A1t_%C3%A2m)).
flags.fix: traditional Vietnamese instrumental ensemble used for ceremonial music; the music played by such an ensemble
